_comment: Per-ship peer registry — copy to state/peers.json and fill in. NO real hosts ship with the kit; every address here is yours to supply. self.name is this ship's peer identity (short + stable, e.g. the tailnet hostname); source (optional) overrides the envelope source field (default: <name>-mate). NAMING CONVENTION (enforced by the envelope allowlist): the effective source MUST match ^ship-[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]*-mate$ (live examples: ship-windows-mate, ship-mac-mate) — so name your ship ship-<x>, or set source explicitly. transports are tried in order per peer: scp (push into the peer's inbox/drops/ over ssh, verify-landed), http (POST {type:'peer',from,text} to the peer's /inbox endpoint), outbox (passive — the message sits in our inbox/drops/outbox/ for the peer's poller). See modules/peer-comms/peer-comms.md.

ship-beta.notes: free text: who this is, what polls what, thread history
